# KOLINN_NAV
> A terminal-inspired, high-performance design system and navigation framework built with Astro.

## Core System
- [Architecture](/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Technical overview of the SSG approach and component hierarchy.
- [Design Tokens](/docs/DESIGN_TOKENS.md): Detailed specification of the Nord-based token system (Primitives, Semantic, Themes).
- [Accessibility](/docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md): a11y implementation details including motion comfort and keyboard navigation.
- [Performance](/docs/PERFORMANCE.md): Optimization strategies for LCP, CLS, and FID.

## Documentation & Guides

- [Theming & Tokens](/blog/guides/theming-and-tokens): How to extend and customize the visual language.
